title: Shortest Path in Binary Matrix
statement:
Given an n x n binary matrix `grid`, return the length of the shortest clear path from the top-left cell to the bottom-right cell.
A clear path visits only 0 cells and may move to any of the 8 adjacent cells.
Return -1 if there is no clear path.
hints: BFS on the grid. Each move has equal cost, so BFS gives the shortest length.
Start only if grid[0][0] is 0. Mark cells visited as you enqueue them.

solution.approach: 8-direction BFS from (0,0). Record distance in the queue. First time you reach (n-1,n-1) is the answer.

analogy: crossing a treasure map that allows diagonal steps
